annotations.description: The opening hand of Forest, Island, Crawling Sensation, Nessian Hornbeetle, Hunter's Edge, Read the Tides, and Talrand, Sky Summoner is a very keepable 7-card hand. It has two lands of different colors, a strong curve (2-drop, 3-drop, 4-drop), and powerful late-game cards. While it only has 2 lands, the curve starts low and the hand has a clear game plan. Mulliganing to 6 gives up a card for no good reason.
annotations.actionTaken: Mulliganed a strong 7-card hand down to 6
annotations.betterLine: Keep the 7-card hand. It has lands, early plays (Nessian Hornbeetle on 2, Crawling Sensation on 3), and powerful mid-to-late game with Talrand and Read the Tides. Two lands is slightly risky but the curve is low enough to function.

annotations.description: Playing Speaker of the Heavens over Anointed Chorister on turn 3 with only 1 mana available. Speaker of the Heavens requires being at 27+ life to activate its ability, which is very difficult to reach. Meanwhile, Anointed Chorister has lifelink and a pump ability ({4}{W}) that could help reach that life threshold later, and is a better early blocker/attacker since both are 1/1s but Speaker needs to survive to eventually be useful. However, Speaker does have vigilance AND lifelink, making it arguably better as an early creature since it can attack and block. The vigilance is meaningful.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Speaker of the Heavens
annotations.betterLine: Cast Anointed Chorister — both are 1/1 lifelink for W, but Chorister has a relevant pump ability that can be used with the green mana the deck runs, while Speaker's activated ability (needing 27 life) is extremely unlikely to be activated in a normal game. However, Speaker's vigilance is a real upside, so this is close.

annotations.description: Cast Duskshell Crawler before playing a land. While the end result is the same in this specific case, playing a land first is strictly better sequencing - it provides maximum information and flexibility before committing mana to a spell.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Duskshell Crawler before making land drop
annotations.betterLine: Play Island first, then cast Duskshell Crawler. This follows the fundamental principle of playing lands before spells to maximize options.

annotations.description: Cast Brushstrider before playing the Plains land drop. Playing Plains first would have opened up the option to cast Garruk's Uprising (2G) instead, which is likely the stronger play given the hand contains Affectionate Indrik (4/4) and Garruk's Gorehorn (7/3) that would each trigger Uprising's card draw. Even if Brushstrider was the intended play, casting before the land drop is a sequencing mistake that limits options.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Brushstrider before playing Plains land drop
annotations.betterLine: Play Plains first, then cast Garruk's Uprising (2G) to set up card draw triggers for the multiple power 4+ creatures in hand

annotations.description: Duskshell Crawler (0/3) could freely block either attacker (summoning sickness doesn't prevent blocking). Blocking Speaker of the Heavens would prevent 1 damage and 1 life gain (lifelink), a 2-point life differential swing. Opponent has no untapped mana for combat tricks, so there's zero risk.
annotations.actionTaken: Declined to block, taking 2 damage (and opponent gaining 1 life from Speaker's lifelink).
annotations.betterLine: Block Speaker of the Heavens with Duskshell Crawler to save 1 damage and prevent 1 lifelink life gain, at no cost (Crawler survives as 0/2).

annotations.description: Chose Revitalize (gain 3 life, draw a card) over Garruk's Uprising when holding multiple power 4+ creatures (Affectionate Indrik, Garruk's Gorehorn) and Garruk, Unleashed. Uprising would have provided trample for the team immediately (relevant against opponent's small blockers) and set up a card-draw engine for subsequent turns when casting big creatures.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Revitalize for 3 life and a card draw
annotations.betterLine: Cast Garruk's Uprising to establish trample for all creatures and set up card draw triggers for the multiple power 4+ creatures in hand

annotations.description: Duskshell Crawler (0/3) could have blocked Speaker of the Heavens (1/1) or Anointed Chorister (1/1) for free — the Crawler would survive (3 toughness vs 1 power) while preventing 1 damage and 1 lifelink lifegain. There is no downside to this block.
annotations.actionTaken: Declined to block with Duskshell Crawler, taking 5 damage total and letting opponent gain 2 life from lifelink.
annotations.betterLine: Block Speaker of the Heavens (or Anointed Chorister) with Duskshell Crawler to prevent 1 damage and 1 lifegain at zero cost. The Crawler survives the block.

annotations.description: Speaker of the Heavens has vigilance and lifelink, meaning there's essentially no downside to attacking with it. It stays untapped for its activated ability, and any damage dealt gains life toward the 27-life threshold needed for its token-making ability. The opponent is unlikely to block a 1/1 with their valuable Talrand. Anointed Chorister with lifelink is also arguably worth sending since the opponent probably won't trade Talrand for it.
annotations.actionTaken: Attacked with only Brushstrider, leaving Speaker of the Heavens and Anointed Chorister back.
annotations.betterLine: Attack with at least Brushstrider and Speaker of the Heavens (vigilance means no cost), and likely Anointed Chorister too. The lifelink damage helps reach the 27-life threshold for Speaker's powerful ability, and the opponent is unlikely to sacrifice Talrand to block a 1/1.

annotations.description: Talrand, Sky Summoner is by far the most valuable creature on MiMo's board - it generates 2/2 flying tokens for each instant/sorcery cast, and MiMo has Befuddle and Wizard's Retort in hand. Trading Talrand for a Brushstrider (3/1 vigilance) is an extremely poor exchange. Talrand was poised to take over the game.
annotations.actionTaken: Blocked Brushstrider 3/1 with Talrand, Sky Summoner 2/2, trading the most important creature on the board for a vanilla 3/1.
annotations.betterLine: Don't block. Taking 3 damage (going to 10 life) is a very reasonable cost to preserve Talrand, who would generate enormous value with Befuddle and Wizard's Retort in hand. Alternatively, block with Duskshell Crawler if you must block, though even that trade is unfavorable.

annotations.description: Cast Ironshell Beetle before playing a land drop. While the end state is functionally identical in this case, playing lands before casting spells is a fundamental sequencing principle - it maximizes flexibility and provides information before committing mana. If the land had been an Island instead of Forest, or if something unexpected occurred, having the extra land in play first could matter.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Ironshell Beetle before playing a land
annotations.betterLine: Play Forest (or Island) first, then cast Ironshell Beetle. This follows proper sequencing of land-before-spells and costs nothing.

annotations.description: Speaker of the Heavens has vigilance, meaning attacking with it is completely free — it stays untapped regardless. If blocked by Duskshell Crawler (0/3), Speaker deals 1 damage and gains 1 life while taking 0. If unblocked, it deals 1 damage to the opponent and gains 1 life. Every point of life matters toward reaching the 27 life threshold to activate Speaker's angel-creating ability. There is zero downside to attacking with a vigilance creature here.
annotations.actionTaken: Declined to attack with any creatures, including the vigilance Speaker of the Heavens.
annotations.betterLine: Attack with at least Speaker of the Heavens (free due to vigilance) for incremental life gain and damage. Anointed Chorister could also attack since the opponent's only untapped blocker is Duskshell Crawler (0/3 which deals no damage back).

annotations.description: GPT5 Teach timed out and failed to activate Garruk, Unleashed in the postcombat main phase. The -2 ability would create a 3/3 Beast token, and since the opponent controls more creatures (3 vs 2), Garruk would gain a loyalty counter back (staying at 3). This wastes a free 3/3 body and the chance to build toward Garruk's ultimate.
annotations.actionTaken: Timed out and passed without activating Garruk, Unleashed
annotations.betterLine: Activate Garruk's -2 to create a 3/3 green Beast creature token, gaining the loyalty counter back due to opponent having more creatures

annotations.description: Cast Befuddle targeting Anointed Chorister (1/1) while Garruk's -2 ability was on the stack about to create a 3/3 Beast token. The -4/-0 on a 1/1 is meaningless, whereas waiting for the Beast to resolve and then casting Befuddle on the 3/3 Beast would reduce it to -1/3, neutering its attack through trample (from Garruk's Uprising) for a turn.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Befuddle targeting Anointed Chorister (1/1) while the Beast token ability was still on the stack
annotations.betterLine: Let Garruk's -2 ability resolve, creating the 3/3 Beast token, then cast Befuddle on the Beast to make it -1/3 and draw a card — more impactful since the Beast with trample is the real threat

annotations.description: Attacked with Duskshell Crawler (0/3) which deals 0 damage and risks being killed by the opponent's 3/3 Beast token, losing the trample-enabling effect for Vodalian Arcanist. Also attacked with Ironshell Beetle (1/1) which is easily blocked. Meanwhile, Vodalian Arcanist (3/5 with trample from Duskshell Crawler) was left back despite being the most impactful attacker.
annotations.actionTaken: Attacked with Duskshell Crawler (0/3) and Ironshell Beetle (1/1), leaving Vodalian Arcanist (3/5 trample) back.
annotations.betterLine: Either attack with Vodalian Arcanist alone (3/5 with trample pushes damage and survives most blocks) or don't attack at all. Duskshell Crawler should never attack since it deals 0 damage and is a key trample enabler that shouldn't be risked. Keeping Vodalian Arcanist untapped for Wizard's Retort mana is reasonable, but then no creatures should attack.

annotations.description: Used Garruk's -2 to create a summoning-sick 3/3 token, killing Garruk (drops to 0 loyalty with no refund since GPT5 Teach controls more creatures). The +1 would have pumped the existing Beast Token to 6/6, dealt ~7 damage through the mostly-tapped board (opponent at 13 → 6), and kept Garruk alive at 3 loyalty for future activations.
annotations.actionTaken: Activated Garruk's -2 to create a 3/3 Beast token (summoning sick, can't attack), sacrificing Garruk at 0 loyalty.
annotations.betterLine: Activate Garruk's +1 on the Beast Token (making it 6/6 with trample), then attack with Beast Token, Anointed Chorister, and Speaker of the Heavens. With only Ironshell Beetle untapped to block, this deals ~7 damage (opponent to 6) while preserving Garruk at 3 loyalty.

annotations.description: MiMo Proud declined to block with Ironshell Beetle (1/1) despite being at 13 life facing 5 incoming damage. The Beetle has already used its ETB and is expendable. Blocking Speaker of the Heavens would trade the 1/1 Beetle for the Speaker (removing a lifelink/vigilance creature with dangerous late-game potential) and save 1 life. With Garruk's Uprising giving trample, blocking the 3/3 Beast only saves 1 damage anyway, so blocking Speaker is the best option.
annotations.actionTaken: Did not block, taking 5 damage (going to 8 life).
annotations.betterLine: Block Speaker of the Heavens with Ironshell Beetle to trade the expendable 1/1 for a potentially dangerous creature and save 1 point of damage.

annotations.description: Failed to assign free blocks that would have killed opponent's creatures at no cost. The Drowsing Tyrannodon (3/3) could block and kill Ironshell Beetle (1/1) taking only 1 damage, and the Beast Token (3/3) could block and kill Duskshell Crawler (0/3) taking 0 damage. The Duskshell Crawler is particularly relevant as it grants trample to the opponent's Vodalian Arcanist which has +1/+1 counters.
annotations.actionTaken: No blocks assigned (timeout/no response), taking 1 damage
annotations.betterLine: Block Duskshell Crawler with Beast Token (kills it for free, removes trample enabler) and block Ironshell Beetle with Drowsing Tyrannodon (kills it, taking only 1 damage)

annotations.description: GPT5 Teach passed priority in precombat main phase when casting Garruk's Harbinger (1GG) would enable lethal. The Harbinger is a 4/3, which enables Drowsing Tyrannodon to attack (power 4+ creature requirement). With Garruk's Uprising giving trample, the full attack of Harbinger 4/3 + two Beast 3/3s + Tyrannodon 3/3 + Chorister 1/1 + Speaker 1/1 = 15 trampling damage against an opponent at 8 life with virtually no untapped blockers (Caustic Caterpillar is sick). This is missed lethal.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority in precombat main phase without casting any spells.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Garruk's Harbinger (1GG) precombat, draw a card from Garruk's Uprising trigger, then attack with all creatures for lethal trampling damage against the tapped-out opponent at 8 life.

annotations.description: MiMo Proud is at 8 life facing exactly 8 damage from attackers (1+1+3+3). By not blocking with the available Caustic Caterpillar, they take lethal damage and lose the game. Blocking a 3/3 Beast Token would reduce incoming damage to 5, leaving them alive at 3 life.
annotations.actionTaken: Declined to assign any blockers, taking 8 damage at 8 life (lethal).
annotations.betterLine: Block one of the 3/3 Beast Tokens with Caustic Caterpillar to reduce incoming damage to 5, surviving at 3 life.

annotations.description: GPT5 Teach is attacking for exactly lethal (1+1+3+3=8 against 8 life) but declined to activate Anointed Chorister's {4}{W} pump ability to get +3/+3, which would provide 11 damage instead of 8. With 5 untapped lands (3 Forest, 2 Plains), the activation was free since the game ends on resolution. The opponent has 3 cards in hand and 1 untapped Island - while unlikely they can prevent lethal, pumping provides insurance against any unexpected interaction at zero cost.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority without activating Anointed Chorister's pump ability during combat
annotations.betterLine: Activate Anointed Chorister's {4}{W} ability to pump it to 4/4, providing 3 extra damage as insurance against any possible interaction when attacking for exact lethal
